description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface and wraps Android's native Log utility to enable flexible and chainable logging. It forwards log messages to the next node in a linked list of log handlers, allowing for customizable log processing.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate chained logging with the ability to forward logs to another LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which this LogWrapper should forward log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a given priority, tag, optional Throwable, and passes the log to the next LogNode if present.
